registeredPlan.purpose: Improve overlap decoding without tuning on exposed test channels
registeredPlan.split: tune only; old test remains exposed and excluded
registeredPlan.inferenceBudget: Reuse authenticated cached browser logits only. No Node/cloud ML inference. No repeated inference for thresholds.
registeredPlan.folds: Leave one channel out; choose only on remaining channels and evaluate excluded channel once per fixed candidate
registeredPlan.trainingSelection: At least one matched sponsor at IoU>=0.5 and provisional agreement precision>=0.95; maximize recall, then coverage recall, then minimize unknown predicted seconds, then prefer baseline family/threshold closest to 0.8
promotionRequirements: At least 3 positive channels and 12 sponsor references
Out-of-fold provisional precision>=0.95 and recall not below baseline
Out-of-fold coverage recall increases and unknown predicted seconds not above baseline
Reviewed negative exposure and independent fresh test before automatic skipping
registeredPlan.unknownRegions: Unmatched predictions remain unknown, never relabeled as false positives or ordinary content
registeredPlan.trainingOverlap: Unknown upstream training overlap explicitly retained; no independent-generalization claim
registeredPlan.frozenBenchmark: No modification of original manifest, frozen config, adapters, test ledger or old results

scope: Development tune channels only. Existing test data not read. Cached Chrome logits only, no inference.

before.method: RSS sum (ps KiB); vm_stat native pages
before.scope: same-UID process RSS including unrelated apps and shared-page duplication; host availability proxy = free + inactive + speculative pages, not guaranteed allocatable memory; purgeable pages not added twice

limitations: SponsorBlock references are provisional and partial
Cross-validation is development evidence, not a fresh independent test
